semantic_correction_reason: Trader supplied two additional real screen-recording videos and direct labels before any clean v2.4 performance result was observed. A prior sealed attempt aborted with an ArrayMemoryError before a ledger/edge result was produced. The new evidence clarifies that momentum is watched while the trigger candle is forming: the trader enters before the parent 5m/15m close once sustained buyer/seller force is proven because waiting for the close can be materially late against the frozen 17.25-point stop. Historical/live parity therefore uses only completed 1m sub-bars available at each decision clock, penalizes tug-of-war/giveback, and forbids final parent-candle OHLC from backdating an earlier entry. All existing location, displacement, breakout, range-room, first-reaction TP, risk and edge gates remain unchanged.

active_map_policy.range_day_fresh_entry_zone_rule: When the causal pre-open structure is MIXED/ranging, preserve nearby structure as reaction/TP context but remove fresh-entry authorization from zones that do not leave the already-frozen minimum room from the active range edge.

key_level_semantics.inflection_rule: A valid zone may reject, reclaim, break, accept, retest or later flip role; touching it does not predict direction.

candlestick_semantics.legacy_pattern_label_note: The recognizer's historical BULLISH/BEARISH_LONG_BODY_DISPLACEMENT label is a pattern-taxonomy name only. Executable true displacement is separately defined by the entry-fidelity contract as momentum plus range expansion; not every strong red/green momentum candle is displacement.

entry_trigger_semantics.momentum_candle: Directional control geometry using frozen body/close thresholds; range expansion is not required.
entry_trigger_semantics.live_force: forming parent candle must satisfy partial momentum geometry, path efficiency >= Params.body_frac, latest completed 1m close at the directional extreme, at least two completed 1m observations, and parent candle still open
entry_trigger_semantics.historical_force_resolution: completed 1m sub-bars only; no tick-order inference and no final parent OHLC backdating
entry_trigger_semantics.rejection_entry: authorized key zone -> valid completed rejection/control story -> sustained intra5 directional force -> entry before close when proven
entry_trigger_semantics.normal_breakout: first completed print beyond zone is setup only -> following forming 5m candle may trigger when sustained intra5 directional force is proven
entry_trigger_semantics.weak_breakout: weak first break -> controlled completed pullback -> forming 15m bar3 may trigger when sustained intra15 directional force is proven
entry_trigger_semantics.prebreak_exception_trigger_clock: forming attack/third candle requires sustained intra5 force and may enter before close

directional_examples.support_rejection_long: price reaches support; doji/pin/inside/shrinking or equivalent completed rejection story shows sellers failing; forming bullish trigger candle must prove sustained intra5 force and may enter before its close
directional_examples.resistance_rejection_short: price reaches resistance; doji/pin/inside/shrinking or equivalent completed rejection story shows buyers failing; forming bearish trigger candle must prove sustained intra5 force and may enter before its close
directional_examples.resistance_breakout_long: first completed print above resistance is setup; the following forming 5m candle can confirm with sustained bullish force before close, or a weak break may pull back and later use forming 15m bar3 force
directional_examples.support_breakout_short: first completed print below support is setup; the following forming 5m candle can confirm with sustained bearish force before close, or a weak break may pull back and later use forming 15m bar3 force
directional_examples.resistance_break_retest_long: resistance is genuinely broken and accepted, retests as support, then sustained bullish live force confirms
directional_examples.support_break_retest_short: support is genuinely broken and accepted, retests as resistance, then sustained bearish live force confirms
directional_examples.prebreak_long_exception: repeat-test attack or genuine displacement sequence may trigger before a completed print above resistance only after sustained live force
directional_examples.prebreak_short_exception: repeat-test attack or genuine displacement sequence may trigger before a completed print below support only after sustained live force

target_semantics.first_reaction_priority: Whichever valid meaningful reaction area has the nearest physical first-contact edge in the trade direction owns the TP decision. A nearer 5m liquidity cluster outranks a farther 15m FVG; a nearer active 15m FVG outranks a farther liquidity cluster. No farther feature may leapfrog the nearer meaningful reaction area.
target_semantics.overlap_policy: When a 5m cluster or FVG is internal to the already-winning broad reaction area, it may refine TP only inside that area; it may not move the target beyond the first-reaction owner.
target_semantics.real_user_example_2026_08_18: Trader supplied real screenshots where the liquidity cluster sat in front of the FVG in the trade direction; price reacted at the cluster and did not need to enter the farther FVG, so the cluster owned TP.

anti_overfit.reason: Entry-fidelity, live-force timing, range-room, zone-first candle semantics and first-reaction TP hierarchy were corrected from direct trader evidence before any clean performance result was observed. The force equation reuses frozen body/close geometry and uses a structural two-completed-1m minimum to distinguish persistence from giveback; neither was selected from PnL. No edge, stop, target, room, session or robustness gate was relaxed.
